title: Spira Prime
extract:
The Spira Prime is the Prime variant of the  Spira throwing daggers, featuring an increase in fire rate, reload speed, status chance, and critical multiplier in exchange for reduced damage. It was released alongside  Saryn Prime and  Nikana Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Ragdolls and pins the target to the wall on a kill.
Ragdolled bodies fly in a straight line and can damage other enemies in its path.
Capable of using the thrown-exclusive mod  Concealed Explosives.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Tied with normal  Spira for the highest critical chance of all throwing-type secondaries.
Tied with  Aksomati/ Aksomati Prime and  Plinx for the third highest critical multiplier of all secondaries, behind  Nukor and  Kuva Nukor.
Silent.
Pinpoint accuracy.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very high crit chance (30.00%)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
Very high accuracy (0.00° to 0.00°)
Very high reload speed (0.75 s)
High ammo max (210)
Above average disposition (●●●●○ (1.25x))
Very high crit multiplier (3.00x)
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Projectiles have travel time and travel in an arc, making it hard to hit at longer ranges and achieve headshots.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)

Below average status chance (14.00%)

Acquisition

Vaultings
On December 6th, 2017, it was announced that Spira Prime, alongside  Saryn Prime and  Nikana Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and its relics retired from the drop tables on December 12th, 2017. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.

Trivia
The Spira Prime was originally released in July 2015 on the Chinese build of Warframe, along with Excalibur Umbra Prime and  Nikana Prime.
The Spira Prime was unintentionally leaked in the Codex following Hotfix 18.4.7 (2016-02-04).
The drill tip on the Spira Prime spins, making it the only throwing knife secondary with a non-static animated model.
"Spira" is the Latin word for "spiral" or "coil". The weapon is named this way due to its spinning tips.
